entry_id.description: Stable aligned-record identifier; distinct from a unique Chinese head or concept.

chinese_term_source.description: Provider of the Chinese-English concept name.

source_entry_id.description: Identifier retained from the corresponding Chinese-English provider.

zh_term.description: Chinese head exactly as retained in the frozen core.

en_term_zh_source.description: English name supplied by the Chinese-English source.

en_term_issai.description: English name in the ISSAI alignment source.

ru_term.description: Russian form retained for provenance or verification.

kk_term_cyrillic.description: Raw Cyrillic Kazakh display form; may contain declared alternatives rather than a single disambiguated lemma.

alignment_method.description: Recorded alignment procedure; does not imply manual semantic adjudication.

alignment_status.description: Recorded source-table status; does not imply a redistribution license.
